arabic text: KEHTI THI ZAINAB HAAYE HUSAINA\nHOGAYI BARBAD HAI ZAINAB KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: ZAINAB SAID ‘O HUSSAIN – ZAINAB HAS BEEN RUINED IN KARBALA’

arabic text: SHER-E-MADINA, NANI SAKINA\nDHOONDTI HAI BAAP KA SINA – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: THE PRINCESS OF MEDINA, THE LITTLE SAKINA\nIS SEARCHING TO LAY ON HER FATHER’S CHEST – IN KARBALA

arabic text: LAILA KI UMMID, AKBAR KI JAWANI\nKYA KARE LAACHAR HAI LAILA – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: LAILA’S HOPES WERE TIED TO HER YOUTHFUL SON AKBER\nWHAT DOES SHE DO NOW HAVING LOST HER HOPES – IN KARBALA

arabic text: SEENE PE NEZA, AKBAR KO LAGII THI\nROTI THII MAA USKI JAWAANI – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: AKBER HAD A SPEAR HIT HIM IN THE CHEST\nHIS MOTHER WEPT FOR HIM – IN KARBALA

arabic text: DEKHIYE SITAM, BABA YA ALI\nKAISI MUSIBAT MAI HAI ZAINAB – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: O FATHER ALI, LOOK AT WHAT SITUATION ZAINAB IS IN\nSHE IS FACING ALL THESE PROBLEMS – IN KARBALA

arabic text: BIBIYON KE SAR, PAR NAHIN CHADAR\nAAWO MADAD KE LIYE BABA – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: THE WOMEN HAVE NO COVERINGS ON THEIR HEADS\nCOME SUPPORT THEM O FATHER – IN KARBALA

arabic text: TEERON ME ASGHAR, NEZE PE AKBAR\nFATIMA KI LOOTI KAMAAYI – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: ASGHER BY AN ARROW, AKBER BY A SPEAR\nTHEY ROBBED FATIMA OF HER CHILDREN – IN KARBALA

arabic text: LUT GAYA SAB GHAR, QATL HUSAINA\nHOGAYI BARBAD HAI ZAINAB – KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: THE HOLY HOUSEHOLD WAS LOOTED, HUSSAIN HAS BEEN BEHEADED\nZAINAB HAS BEEN RUINED – IN KARBALA

arabic text: HAATHON ME RASAN, KAISE DUN KAFAN\nSAR PE NAHI HAI MERE CHADAR - KARBOBALA MEIN
english translation text: WITH ROPES IN HER HANDS, HOW CAN SHE SHROUD YOUR BODY?\nSHE DOESN'T HAVE A COVERING ON HER HEAD - IN KARBALA
